title: Billing Standard: Spend Measure for Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewal Loyalty Credits
content:
## Definitions

- **Twelve-month sum:** the sum of the amounts of every bill line of the Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement, credits and rebill credits included, posted later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date.
- **Twenty-four-month sum:** the same sum over every bill line posted later than the same calendar day twenty-four months before the acceptance date.

Credits and rebill credits are carried on the bill lines as negative amounts, so they reduce each sum.

## Standard

The spend the renewal loyalty credit is sized on is measured over a window that follows the agreement's billing history, counted by the energy charge lines on file:

| Energy charge lines on file | Spend |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | Half the twenty-four-month sum, rounded half up to the cent |
| At least 12 but fewer than 24 | The twelve-month sum |
| Fewer than 12 | The twelve-month sum multiplied by twelve and divided by the number of energy charge lines on file, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked measures (hypothetical bill histories, acceptance date 2025-11-20)

The twelve-month sum takes lines posted on 2024-11-21 or later; the twenty-four-month sum takes lines posted on 2023-11-21 or later.

| Energy charge lines on file | Sum used | Spend |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | Twenty-four-month sum $41,000.51 | $20,500.255, rounded to $20,500.26 |
| 18 | Twelve-month sum $16,250.40 | $16,250.40 |
| 12 | Twelve-month sum $14,900.00 | $14,900.00 |
| 8 | Twelve-month sum $9,000.00 | $9,000.00 multiplied by 12 and divided by 8, that is $13,500.00 |

A rebill credit of $420.00 posted on the agreement inside the window lowers the sum it falls in by $420.00.
